title: Beyond Task Success: Stage-Wise Reliability of World Model Planning under Sensing Degradation
abstract: arXiv:2609.07126v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In world model planning, sensing inputs pass through an encoder and predictor before affecting planner decisions, so final task success alone cannot reveal where sensing disturbances attenuate or persist in the pipeline. We apply 10 visual and temporal sensing degradations to a world model planner and track their effects across representation, future prediction, planner preference, and physical outcome using paired evaluation on the same 50 tasks. The relative impact of degradations was not preserved across stages: large representation shifts could attenuate downstream, while smaller initial shifts could persist to the outcome, and internal-response ordering did not directly match physical-outcome ordering. Temporal degradations also showed distinct patterns: even with similar overall changes in observation history, responses differed substantially with the location of corrupted information and the planner's actual exposure. translated_title: 超越任务成功：感知退化下世界模型规划的阶段性可靠性
translated_abstract: 在世界模型规划中，感知输入需要经过编码器和预测器才能影响规划器的决策，因此仅凭最终任务成功无法揭示感知扰动在流水线中的何处衰减或持续。我们对一个世界模型规划器施加10种视觉和时间维度的感知退化，并通过对相同的50个任务进行配对评估，追踪这些退化在表示、未来预测、规划器偏好和物理结果等各阶段的影响。研究发现，退化的相对影响在各阶段之间并未保持一致：较大的表示偏移可能在下游衰减，而较小的初始偏移却可能持续影响到最终结果，且内部响应的排序与物理结果的排序并不直接对应。时间维度的退化也表现出独特的模式：即使观察历史的整体变化相似，响应也会因受损信息的位置以及规划器实际接触到的信息不同而产生显著差异。这种非均[摘要在此处截断]
tldr: 本文通过对世界模型规划器施加10种感知退化并进行跨阶段配对评估，揭示感知扰动的影响在表示、预测、规划偏好和物理结果各阶段间并非均匀传递，因此仅凭任务成功无法可靠评估世界模型规划的抗扰性能。
en_tdlr: By applying 10 visual and temporal sensing degradations to a world model planner with paired stage-wise evaluation, this paper shows that perturbation effects propagate non-uniformly across representation, prediction, planner preference, and physical outcomes, meaning task success alone cannot reveal planning reliability.
